title: Single command control path
purpose: Exercise a distinct control-direction I-format parser path using documented TypeID 45 with a compact single information object.
expected_behavior: Peer parses a valid single-command ASDU and either accepts or application-rejects it cleanly based on local configuration, without parser failure.
constraints_preserved: Length octet 0x0e is consistent with APCI plus 10-byte ASDU
Single information object with 3-byte IOA and 1-byte command qualifier/value field
Framing remains within conservative valid 104 I-format structure
issue_safety_notes: Chosen as a safe alternative parser path near I-format handling implicated by the issue, but not matching the crash sample structure.
